title: Meet the Hashed Vibe Labs Fellows
summary: Meet eighteen fellows building at the forefront of open source, AI, security, finance, and creative work, and learn about their backgrounds.
content:
Through our fellowship program, we invited advisors to work with the teams selected for Hashed Vibe Labs. So many remarkable people have joined us. Developers behind world-class open-source projects, a Cannes Lions-winning creative director, a member of the presidential AI committee, one of the world's top three hackers, a Kaggle Grandmaster, and even a next-generation developer still in high school. Their fields, ages, and backgrounds are all different, but they have one thing in common. They build hands-on, at the forefront, at speed.

I'm really looking forward to Vibe Labs Seoul Edition, where all 18 fellows will come together. Stay tuned to see what they create together.

Applications for Hashed Vibe Labs Seoul Edition close on the 19th.

[https://n.news.naver.com/mnews/article/015/0005251155?sid=101](https://n.news.naver.com/mnews/article/015/0005251155?sid=101)

**(Listed below in Korean alphabetical order)
**
**Min-su Kim - CEO of Contxts.io | Former engineer at Meta and Ground X**

Runs NFTBank, a digital asset valuation and portfolio management platform. Has raised funding from Hashed, Sequoia, DCG, 1kx, and others. Developing algorithms to determine the fair value of onchain assets, with a vision of building the NFT market's 'Bloomberg Terminal.'

**Simon Kim - CEO of Hashed**

An investor and hands-on builder, and a serial entrepreneur with two exits. Actively invests in the Web3 ecosystem while personally developing Web3 and AI projects, including ETHval, Agenlinter, and Promptguard.

**Yeon-gyu Kim - Open-source developer | Creator of oh-my-opencode**

Creator of Oh My Opencode, a globally recognized orchestration project with 30,000 GitHub stars and 600,000 downloads. Runs a global coding agent community and is helping make AI coding tools accessible to everyone.

**Ho-jin Kim - CEO of Hashed Open Finance | CEO of ShardLab**

Building new infrastructure at the intersection of decentralized finance (DeFi) and traditional finance. Collaborates with a range of protocols to bring onchain financial services to a wider audience.

**Woong-ki Min - Software engineer at FriendliAI**

A core contributor to global open-source projects including Vercel AI SDK and vLLM. An engineer recognized for substantive code contributions to inference efficiency and serving optimization for large language models.

**Ki-heon Shin - Creative director with 19 years of experience**

A veteran creative director and Cannes Lions winner. Applying expertise in branding and communication strategy to new forms of expression in the AI era.

**Su-bin Ahn - Tech Lead at Hashed | Kaggle Grandmaster**

A data scientist who reached the global number one ranking on the onchain analytics platform Dune. Holds the title of Kaggle Grandmaster. An expert in turning complex blockchain data into insights, and an AI developer.

**Jun-ho Yeo - Founder of Stroke Company | Runs Sisyphus Labs**

A developer with over 5,000 GitHub stars. Runs Sisyphus Labs, building tools that automate repetitive, laborious tasks, with a focus on improving developer productivity.

**Yong-jun Lee - Co-founder of Factomind | Former bond trader at Citigroup**

Founded Factomind, an AI-powered investment insights platform, drawing on trading experience on Wall Street. Author of 'Insider Insight,' with deep insight into financial market analysis.

**Jae-hong Lee - Founder of Across Inc.**

Leads a GEO/AEO (Generative Engine Optimization) startup that optimizes LLM search results. Defining a new kind of SEO for the AI era and changing how brands appear in AI answers.

**Wan-seob Lim - Founder of Loqu | Former applied cryptography team lead at the Ethereum Foundation**

A core researcher who developed a first-generation rollup based on zero-knowledge proofs (ZKP). Working to commercialize privacy-preserving technologies, drawing on experience leading cryptography research at the Ethereum Foundation.

**Seong-young Jung - Founder of MarketFit Lab | Growth hacking expert**

Runs Korea's largest group of growth hacking experts. Previously a growth consultant at Samsung Electronics C-Lab and Kakao Ventures, designing growth strategies for numerous startups.

**Ki-young Ju - Founder of CryptoQuant**

A global leader in onchain data analytics. Has over 420,000 Twitter followers, with crypto traders around the world referring to his analysis. Recently co-founded unbias.fyi, expanding his work on data-driven decision-making tools.

**Sigrid Jin - Engineer at Sionic AI | **[**Instruct.KR**](http://instruct.kr/)** organizer**

Runs the AI engineering community Instruct.KR, helping grow Korea's AI developer ecosystem. A heavy user and hands-on AI engineer who ranked number one worldwide in Claude Code token usage on viberank.app last year.

**Yong-ho Ha - CEO of DataOven | Presidential AI Strategy Committee**

A serial entrepreneur with two ML startup exits. Currently serves on the Presidential AI Strategy Committee, helping shape national AI policy and contributing to practical uses of data and AI.

**Min-pyo Hong - Founder of SEWORKS | Founder of the hacker group WOWHACKER**

A cybersecurity expert known as one of the world's top three hackers. Founded the WOWHACKER group and the security company SEWORKS. Has distinctive expertise in designing defenses from an attacker's perspective.

**In-ha Hwang - Incoming student at Busan Il Science High School | Open-source community contributor**

A next-generation developer who actively contributes to open-source projects while still in high school. HVL's youngest fellow, embodying a vibe coding culture that recognizes skill regardless of age.
